hero.badge: Live SaaS Production Ready at Story.Menu
hero.subtitle: Welcome to Story.Menu—the ultimate interactive AI creator suite where epic multi-agent narrative arcs, locked character DNA, and real-time synth soundtracks are served on-demand.

sandbox.title: 🎮 Prompt Sandbox Arena
sandbox.desc: The <1>Prompt Sandbox</1> allows you to prototype universe layouts and story nodes. Input a custom premise or pick a preset below, then synthesize your design.
sandbox.placeholder: A cybernetic samurai defending a neon city gate...
sandbox.preset1: A neon cyberpunk detective looking at a glowing holographic map on a rainy street.
sandbox.preset2: An astronaut discovering an ancient mystical stone temple on Mars.
sandbox.preset3: A cute wizard apprentice accidentally setting their spellbook on fire.
sandbox.generateDesc: Synthesizes a mockup story block demonstrating <1>visual rendering</1>, <1>casting vault identity</1>, and <1>synth soundtracks</1> matching the prompt.
sandbox.runGenerator: Run the generator sandbox above to witness a dynamic preview.

showcase.title: Artisanal & Storybook Styles
showcase.desc: Choose a visual framework that aligns with your story's soul. Hand-drawn aesthetics meet modern SaaS tools.

audio.title: Interactive Soundscapes
audio.subtitle: Web Audio procedural synth engine
audio.desc: Every multiverse genre carries its own generative procedural theme. Change genres to watch the synthetic frequency arpeggios shift live in your browser's audio nodes.
audio.sfxDesc: Click any trigger block to command the sound synthesis engine directly.
audio.warning: Ensure your system audio is enabled to hear procedural sounds.

features.title: Built For Dynamic Multi-Tenant Publishing
features.desc: A high-end creative workshop structured to keep your graphic novels continuous, atmospheric, and visually arresting.
features.f1Desc: Map chapter goals from inciting incident triggers on page 1 to decision branches on page 3, climbing to the climax on page 9. Strictly structured outline grids.
features.f2Desc: Forge persistent files containing character biometrics, facial weights, clothing references, and style lock keys. Keep heroes and archenemies consistent.
features.f3Desc: Choose your renderer: LlamaGen.ai (Comic API) for panel grids, Stable Diffusion (via ComfyUI) for raw workflow control, Leonardo.ai (CharRef), or Gemini 2.5 Flash.
features.f4Desc: Hear dialogue panels narrated instantly! Generates character text-to-speech outputs in multiple actor voice accents alongside backing audio.
features.f5Desc: Generative arpeggios, frequency oscillators, and synthesized background themes that adapt dynamically to your selected story genres.
features.f6Desc: Compile completed comics directly to high-fidelity PDF documents. Automatically packages page layouts, panels, speech bubbles, and text logs.

pricing.title: Choose Your Multiverse Studio Tier
pricing.desc: Instantly deploy professional-grade publication features and take your original comics directly to your global audience.
pricing.p1Desc: Design in transient browser memory. Perfect for casual creators sketching out individual panel frames.
pricing.p2Desc: Our signature recipe for continuous multi-chapter epics. Secure Web Cloud Firestore database backing.
pricing.p2F1: ✓ Secure Web Cloud Firestore database backing
pricing.p3Desc: Our full-suite solution for professional studios managing continuous, Firestore-backed 10-chapter epic blueprints.

cta.title: Ready to claim your place in the multiverse?
cta.desc: Unlock the creative potential of multimodal artificial intelligence. Draft script blueprints, mold actors, and release immersive visual graphic books safely stored in Firestore today.

dashboard.proDesc: Designed for writers, authors, and narrative designers seeking smart procedural story arcs and high-fidelity speech narration.
dashboard.cloudDesc: Fully Integrated Cloud Storage via Google Firestore. Your characters and epic progress are synchronized live!
dashboard.f1Desc: Guided by state-of-the-art multimodal context windows to synthesize adaptive scenario dialogues, actions, and captions.
dashboard.f2Desc: Cast recurring characters from your Vault. Upload portrait templates to propagate coherent visual traits.
dashboard.f3Desc: Publish, preview, review, and organize custom dynamic comic issues in your personal cloud studio library.

cast.descEditorial: Identify characters to participate in the narrative arc. Upload images of your characters to synchronize consistent physical traits recursively during scenario drafts.
cast.descComic: Upload custom character images to create coherent comic likenesses throughout the adventure. Include a Villain for high-stakes conflicts!
